findings.title: About the security content of iOS 27.2.1 and iPadOS 27.2.1
findings.summary_md: Apple released iOS 27.2.1 and iPadOS 27.2.1 on November 9, 2026, fixing nine vulnerabilities across AirPlay, App Intents, Bluetooth, brotli, CoreUtils, Messages, and rapportd. The Messages fixes include CVE-2026-113961, which could let a remote attacker join an iMessage group chat and receive its messages, and CVE-2026-113960, which could let a user added to a group access messages sent before they joined. The update is available for iPhone 11 and later and corresponding iPad models.

findings.title: Apple releases iOS 27.2.1 for iPhone, here's what's new
findings.summary_md: Apple released iOS 27.2.1 for iPhone on November 9, 2026, a minor software update for iPhone users. The release followed the earlier iOS 27.2 update.

findings.title: Apple Releases iOS 27.2.1 With Bug Fixes
findings.summary_md: Apple released iOS 27.2.1 on November 9, 2026, a minor update to the iOS 27 operating system. The release came two weeks after iOS 27.2.

findings.title: Apple releases iOS 27.2.1 with bug fixes for iPhone
findings.summary_md: Apple released iOS 27.2.1 for iPhone on November 9, 2026, a minor software update focused on bug fixes following the larger iOS 27.2 release. The update arrived two weeks after Apple introduced iOS 27.2 on October 26.

findings.title: Apple releases iOS 27.2.1, iPadOS 27.2.1, macOS 27.2.1, watchOS 27.2.1, tvOS 27.2.1, and visionOS 27.2.1
findings.summary_md: Apple released a coordinated set of minor point updates on November 9, 2026, including iOS 27.2.1, iPadOS 27.2.1, macOS 27.2.1, watchOS 27.2.1, tvOS 27.2.1, and visionOS 27.2.1.
